mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned polymetallic VMS project in the Finlayson Lake District, Yukon (~260 km east of Whitehorse; 372 sq km tenure). Development stage: positive Decision Document from Government of Yukon/NRCan/DFO received April 2026 (moves to remaining permitting phase); Type B Water Licence (25-year) received post quarter-end. 2023 Feasibility Study update: pretax NPV7% US$835M, ~2-year payback; nominal 2 Mtpa mine, ~9-year life, ~89% of ore reserves via open pit, balance via Krakatoa underground; three concentrates (high-precious-metals, copper, zinc) with binding offtake for 95% of first five years' production. Probable reserves 15.7 Mt: ABM Zone open pit 13.4 Mt @ 131 g/t Ag, 1.3 g/t Au, 5.9% Zn, 0.9% Cu, 1.5% Pb; Krakatoa Zone open pit 0.6 Mt @ 246 g/t Ag, 1.9 g/t Au, 6.3% Zn, 0.4% Cu, 3.1% Pb; Krakatoa underground 1.7 Mt @ 147 g/t Ag, 1.3 g/t Au, 5.0% Zn, 0.4% Cu, 2.3% Pb. ABM resources (incl. reserves): Indicated 18.3 Mt @ 148 g/t Ag, 1.4 g/t Au, 6.3% Zn, 0.9% Cu, 1.9% Pb; Inferred 0.8 Mt @ 143 g/t Ag, 1.2 g/t Au, 7.2% Zn, 1.0% Cu, 1.7% Pb. Kona deposit: Indicated 2.1 Mt @ 4 g/t Ag, 0.8 g/t Au, 1.6% Cu; Inferred 6.7 Mt @ 4 g/t Ag, 0.6 g/t Au, 1.7% Cu. MD: Michael McClelland.
mines.processing: No processing; development stage (2 Mtpa plant planned)

notes: No longer private: listed on ASX December 12, 2025 (ticker BMC) after an oversubscribed A$100M IPO at A$2.00 per CDI (A$100M raised for drilling, optimisation studies and permitting). Cash of US$50.3M at June 30, 2026 (C$67.2M + US$0.8M + A$3.2M). 20,000 m drilling program underway in 2026 (Fuego prospect and Krakatoa Zone hits, incl. K26-560: 25.1 m @ 180 g/t Ag, 9.7% Zn, 1.0 g/t Au, 0.3% Cu, 3.4% Pb). Incorporated in British Columbia (Canada) and registered as a foreign entity in Australia (ARBN 647 860 124).
